error.missingIssueToken: The issue token is missing. Copy it from your browser as described in the app settings.
error.badIssueToken: That does not look like a Nest issue token. It should start with https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc and contain login_hint.
error.missingCookie: The cookie is missing. Copy it from your browser as described in the app settings.
error.badCookie: That cookie has no __Secure-3PSID value, which is the one the session depends on.
error.brokenCookie: The cookie contains a line break or control character, which usually means the paste was cut short. Copy the whole cookie value again as a single line.
error.notConfigured: Add your issue token and cookie in the app settings first.
error.pairNoConnection: Homey cannot reach Nest right now. Check your internet connection, and that the issue token and cookie in the app settings are still valid.
error.noDevices: No Nest Protect devices were found on this account.
error.deviceGone: This device is no longer on the Nest account.

settings.title: Nest Protect
settings.intro: This app signs in the way the Nest app itself does, because Google's supported API does not cover Nest Protect at all.
settings.warning: The cookie is a full Google account session credential, not a Nest-only token. Keep it out of screenshots and bug reports.
settings.step1: Open home.nest.com in Chrome and sign in with Google.
settings.step2: Open DevTools with F12, go to the Network tab, tick Preserve log, then reload the page.
settings.step3: Filter for issueToken. Open that request and copy its full Request URL into the first field above.
settings.step4: Filter for oauth2/iframe. Under Request Headers, copy the entire cookie value into the second field above.
settings.step5: Close the tab, but do not sign out of Google. Signing out invalidates the cookie.

pair.repairIntro: Your session with Nest has ended. Paste a fresh cookie to reconnect.
pair.repairScope: This reconnects every Nest Protect on the account, not just this one.
